channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: Advanced Shipbuilding Factory of the Future Opens in Alabama
item.description: Funded in part by Navy investments under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), the advanced manufacturing company Hadrian officially opened a new facility in Cherokee, Alabama, on March 20th, which will boost production of US Navy nuclear submarines.

item.title: ICS Releases Crucial Updates to the Guidelines on the Application of the ILO Maritime Labour Convention
item.description: The International Chamber of Shipping (ICS) has released the fifth edition of its Guidelines on the Application of the ILO Maritime Labour Convention, urging the global shipping industry to take note of the latest amendments ahead of their entry into force and to ensure vessels are fully prepared to remain compliant, safe, and fit to trade internationally.

item.title: New WHOI-Led Study Reveals Hidden Chemical Currency Fueling the Ocean’s Carbon Cycle
item.description: A new study, led by Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution (WHOI) and Columbia University, identifies a diverse set of molecules released by marine phytoplankton that fuel microbial life and help drive Earth’s carbon cycle. While scientists know that carbon is moved through an invisible network of phytoplankton and other microbes in the surface ocean, the specific compounds have long been a mystery. item.title: Nexra Wins Additional Near-Term Contract in Taiwan
item.description: Nexra, Cadeler’s dedicated service platform, has confirmed the signing of an additional firm contract for an Operations & Maintenance (O&M) campaign to be executed and completed during 2026.

item.title: Austal USA Awards First Contract Under Strategic Partnership
item.description: Austal USA announced it has signed a contract with Master Boat Builders to fabricate modules for the US Navy’s Navajo-class Towing, Salvage, and Rescue Ship (T-ATS) program. item.title: Vestas Signs Strategic MOU with KPS and KMC to Strengthen Korea’s Offshore Wind Capabilities
item.description: Vestas, the global leader in sustainable energy solutions, has announced the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with KEPCO Plant Service & Engineering Co., Ltd. (KPS) and KMC Line Co., Ltd. (KMC). This strategic agreement aims to accelerate the development of a skilled workforce and high‑quality offshore wind operation and maintenance (O&M) capabilities in Korea, supporting the nation’s renewable energy transition and the growth of its offshore wind industry.

item.title: SBG Systems Unveils Stellar-40
item.description: SBG Systems has expanded its product portfolio with the unveiling of Stellar-40, a modular and scalable inertial navigation system (INS) developed for demanding environments and mission-critical applications.

item.title: First Wind Turbine Installation Completed for Hai Long 3 Offshore Wind Farm
item.description: Jointly developed by Mitsui & Co., Northland Power Inc, and Gentari International Renewables, the Hai Long Offshore Wind Project (Hai Long Project) announced the successful offshore installation of the first wind turbine for the Hai Long 3 wind farms. This achievement signals construction is entering a critical phase and highlights local offshore wind industrial development.

item.title: Carbon storage developers apply for more than 2 million acres of North Sea
item.description: The North Sea Transition Authority (NSTA) received bids for more than 2 million acres of seabed in the UK’s second carbon storage licensing round, which closed on March 24.

item.title: Stillstrom, Faber Group and Prysmian Join Forces to Cut Vessel Emissions Across Offshore Wind Supply Chain
item.description: Stillstrom by Maersk has partnered with Faber Group and Prysmian to launch a pilot offshore charging system that will allow hybrid and electric vessels to connect to clean power while offshore, reducing ship emissions across the offshore wind supply chain.
